Hi Marta — thanks for the clear scope. TL;DR: we can complete the EU-scoped purge and provide a signed proof-of-deletion package; timeline depends on total KV/index size but EOD 9/15 looks feasible pending a short ops window.

Planned approach (high level):
1) Confirm scope: all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and inference logs tied to tenant ID clearbank-prod in EU shards only. (No cross-region material will be touched.)
2) Create immutable wipe_manifest.csv listing all deleted object keys with timestamps and checksums.
3) Run distributed deletion job on EU serving nodes -> collect KV-deletion report (kv_keys_deleted.txt).
4) Generate logfile_digest_*.txt summarizing truncated log shards and line counts; include salted checksums.
5) Produce a signed proof_of_deletion PDF for your legal/audit team.

Ask for you: please confirm that there are no outstanding legal holds or retention exceptions for this tenant and confirm acceptance of our Wipe SLA (single irrevocable sweep). Reply-all to confirm scope.

I'll loop in ops (Aditya) to schedule the run during a quiet window; Marissa will coordinate the customer comms and handoff.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Team — execution summary below (ops run complete).

Scope: tenant clearbank-prod, EU region only. Items targeted: prompt-inputs (S3 prefix), generated outputs (artifact store), inference runtime logs (logging shards 4502-4510).

- Snapshot manifest generated for pre-delete verification. (pre_delete_snapshot.tar.gz)

- KV eviction sweep run, followed by two-pass verification.

- wipe_manifest_20280914.csv (rows: 8,412)
- kv_keys_deleted.txt (rows: 4,120)
- logfile_digest_20280915.txt (summary of 9 shards)

Notes:
- No unexpected errors encountered. Two truncated log segments (shard 4506) required manual compaction; compaction completed at 04:05Z.
- Zero cross-region objects were modified.
- All deleted keys confirmed via checksum reconciliation.

Next steps: Stephanie will create the signed proof_of_deletion PDF and we will share the artifacts with ClearBank audit team.
